user.title: OldPhoneKiosk
user.description: Enable the Home Assistant-native OldPhoneKiosk backend. No external bridge service is required.

pair.title: Pair a phone or tablet

confirm_discovered.title: Pair {name}
confirm_discovered.description:
OldPhoneKiosk found a nearby phone/tablet that is waiting for Home Assistant.

Device: **{name}**
Model: **{model}**
iOS: **{ios}**
App: **{app_version}**
Address: **{host}**

Submit to confirm this is the device and send it a one-time pairing claim. No manual code entry is required for this Wi‑Fi flow.

error.waiting_for_phone: Waiting for the phone/tablet to enter the code and connect.
error.not_connected: The code was used, but the phone/tablet is not connected yet.
error.cannot_connect: Home Assistant could not reach the discovered phone/tablet. Keep the app open on the same local network and try again.

abort.invalid_discovery: The discovered OldPhoneKiosk advertisement was incomplete.
abort.pairing_sent: Pairing was sent to the discovered phone/tablet. It should appear as a device when it connects.
